therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: pleiotropic cardioprotection and anti-inflammatory effects reducing peri-procedural myocardial injury
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Peri-procedural myonecrosis as measured by troponin T at 18-24 hours post-PCI

biomarker_changes: No data analyzed due to small numbers; collected data no longer available as retention period has passed
safety_signals: Trial terminated due to slow recruitment; 4 serious adverse events reported in the screening arm (staged revascularization, increasing shortness of breath, intracranial hemorrhage, cardiorespiratory arrest)

context.indication: Coronary artery disease / acute coronary syndrome undergoing PCI
context.investigator_commentary: Trial was terminated due to slow recruitment. No data was analyzed due to small numbers; collected data no longer available as retention period has passed.

results_by_chain.biology_description: pleiotropic cardioprotection and anti-inflammatory effects reducing myocardial injury
